name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), battle domain (battle core table), descriptor summon_spell_palette_g_table accurately reflects purpose (per-summon palette G/green channel) and data role (a per-summon channel table). The '_g' suffix is the green color channel (a domain-meaningful component distinguishing it from the sibling _r and _b tables), NOT a Ghidra address residue.
purpose: Per-summon VGA palette GREEN-channel byte values for the summon-spell (zhao huan xi / 召喚系) cinematic; one of an adjacent RGB triple (R @ 0x5254F / G @ 0x52553 / B @ 0x52557) used as the interpolation target color during the summon strobe and fade-in.
logic_summary: Scalar uint32 holding 4 LE-packed VGA 6-bit green-channel bytes {3F,39,00,3A} = 0x3A00393F. Consumer fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast (@ 0x27FC9, READ @ 0x27FE3) copies the whole dword into a stack-local, then byte-indexes that LOCAL copy by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20 (0x20..0x23 -> [0]..[3]: 熾天使 G=63, 風妖精 G=57, 破壞神 G=0, 暗邪鬼 G=58) to feed the green argument of fd2_interpolate_palette_range_toward_color. Stored as a scalar (not uint8[4]) because a C array would decay to a pointer at the whole-dword copy and store the address instead of the bytes.
datatype: uint32 (scalar; 4 VGA green-channel bytes LE-packed, NOT uint8[4]; Ghidra DTYPE=dword, len 4)
element_semantics: The 4 packed bytes are per-summon VGA 6-bit (0..63) green-channel intensities, indexed by summon_idx = spell_id - 0x20: byte0=0x20 熾天使=0x3F, byte1=0x21 風妖精=0x39, byte2=0x22 破壞神=0x00, byte3=0x23 暗邪鬼=0x3A.
notes: Values verified by read_memory: r_table@0x5254F={3F,33,35,35}->0x3535333F, g_table@0x52553={3F,39,00,3A}->0x3A00393F, b_table@0x52557={3F,3F,00,09}->0x09003F3F, sfx_bank@0x5255B={5B,5C,5D,5E}; all match src consts in btltab2.c (g = 0x3a00393f). Single xref = READ from fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast @ 0x27FE3 (no writers) -> const. src comment block (btltab2.c lines 115-132) already precise/accurate (covers R/G/B triple together, explains scalar-vs-array rationale, lists values, marks read-only) -> comment_verdict=keep, no src edit. Ghidra data documentation was misplaced in PRE_COMMENT with PLATE empty and a minor 'byte[4]' wording that conflicts with src's 'scalar uint32 (NOT uint8[4])' conclusion; per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism (data plate must be PLATE_COMMENT, PRE forbidden) created a src-consistent PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline and cleared the misplaced PRE_COMMENT.
